description: Map an issue, prompt, or git diff to the repository files worth reading first, the test commands most likely to validate a change, and the areas that deserve review attention. Run this before editing code so the change starts from the right context. Provide at least one of issue, diff, base/head, or workingTree. analysis.nextAction carries the single most useful next step for this report. Read it before acting. Treat the result as a starting map, not proof the task is valid: check the analysis block before editing, and when it reports unresolved or unverified identifiers, vague task grounding, an incomplete scan, or a clustered ranking, widen the search or ask for clarification instead of assuming the top-ranked file is correct.

at.description: Preview (may change before v0.10.0): Rank against this committed Git ref of a local repo, read from Git objects without checking out or changing the worktree. Needs issue; cannot be combined with diff, base/head, workingTree, or a remote repo.

base.description: Base git ref to diff against when diff is not given

diff.description: Git diff spec, such as main...HEAD

evidence.description: Local version-1 evidence bundle files from other tools (data only, never executed). Relevant items are attached to the report.

exclude.description: Path patterns to leave out of ranking, gitignore-flavored, such as "apps/web" or "docs/**". A .fixmapignore file in the repository is applied as well.

format.description: Output format: markdown (default), json, or compact agent, case-insensitive

head.description: Head git ref, defaults to HEAD

issue.description: Issue text, task description, or public GitHub issue URL. A GitHub issue URL supplies the task and infers repo when repo is omitted.

limit.description: Maximum context files to return, 1 to 20, default 8. Lower it when context budget matters: the useful signal is usually the top one to three.

noCache.description: Bypass the exact-state repository scan cache

ref.description: Branch or tag to scan when repo is a remote GitHub URL

repo.description: Local path or public GitHub HTTPS repository URL, defaults to the server working directory. GitHub URLs support issue-only analysis and are removed after scanning.

semanticModel.description: Existing local Transformers.js embedding model directory. Never downloads a model or uploads source.

sensitiveData.description: Preview: attach possible sensitive-data source-to-sink flows (credential, token, PII, payment to logging, network, storage, analytics) touching the report's files. Locations and kinds only; matched values are never included.

supplyChain.description: Preview: local version-1 normalized scanner/SBOM bundle file. Findings for packages declared in manifests among the report's files are attached with tool, database, and bundle provenance.

workingTree.description: Map staged and unstaged tracked changes against HEAD
